name: formulas-in-text
does: Sets formulas typed in plain text the way the slides print them: {{frac:a|b}} stacks, a caret raises, the course's symbols take their subscripts, t1/2 reads t½, a spaced x is a times sign and a spaced hyphen a minus. Applies to questions as they are drawn and to fractions in the reading tabs; stored text is not changed.
source: Basic-Pharmacokinetics src/views.js lines 1-93 and 3496-3505, src/shell.html lines 192-196, at ac2eb73

symbols.about: the course's symbols as [typed, HTML] pairs, longest first: [['VD', 'V<sub>D</sub>'], ['C0', 'C<sub>0</sub>']]

rates.about: the symbols among them that may be written straight before the t they multiply (k0t)

times.about: a spaced x between two factors is a times sign

minus.about: a spaced hyphen before a term, and (- and ^-, are minus signs

powers.about: a caret raises what follows: ^(...) or a signed run
